# JNet: benchmark results by CPU model

<!-- Generated by the benchmark workflow from benchmark-latest.md. Do not edit manually. -->

Median of the per-run BenchmarkDotNet Mean across all CI matrix cells (OS, .NET and JDK combinations) that ran on the same CPU model; the clock frequency reported by BenchmarkDotNet is ignored. The number of runs is in each column header. CPU models seen in fewer than 5 cells are omitted. Allocated is the same on every run. Runners that report no arm64 processor model are grouped with Neoverse-N2.
